lightsNote: All four softboxes are baked into studio-1k.hdr. The posters are lit by that HDR alone (no punctual lights), so for an exact match use scene.environment = HDR, envMapIntensity 1 and do not add these as extra lights.
exposureNote: Blender film exposure +0.25 EV = renderer.toneMappingExposure (linear, applied before tone mapping in both); Blender 'Khronos PBR Neutral' = THREE.NeutralToneMapping
chunkRotationNote: radians about the Three.js Y axis, applied to the GLB root at hero progress 0

entryFace.note: object space of the GLB (before chunkRotationY); centroid and outward normal of the fracture face the camera enters
entryFace.lightNote: chunk rotation the face was picked and lit at; the runtime turns the studio into this frame during the approach, so the close-up does not depend on the hero pose

units: metres, glTF Y-up, chunk centred at origin, longest dimension 1.0
